1. Product Demonstration and Technical Verification in PreBid Meeting The Unit is engaged in the development and fabrication of specialised electronic equipment, as well as the repair, maintenance, and upgradation of specialised systems to meet the customised requirements of various technical projects. Accordingly, all item s procured through the bidding process must meet the prescribed technical specifications, functional requirements, quality stan dards, and compatibility criteria. In view of the specialised nature of these requirements, participation in the Pre-Bid Meeting shall be mandatory for all prospecti ve bidders. Each bidder shall be required to present the relevant product samples, prototypes, or representative units, as applic able, during the Pre-Bid Meeting for technical evaluation, physical inspection, fitment verification, and assessment of build quali ty and compatibility with the intended system. The Unit shall also conduct functional testing and test runs of the submitted items, wherever applicable, to assess their operatio nal performance, reliability, and suitability for the intended application, thereby ensuring their satisfactory performance and usa bility in future deployment. Only those bidders whose submitted samples successfully meet the prescribed technical, qualitative, fitment, and functional requirements, as determined by the competent technical evaluation authority, shall be considered eligible for further participati on in the bidding process, subject to the applicable tender conditions. Failure to attend the mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting, present the required samples, or facilitate the prescribed technical evaluation and testing may result in disqualification from further consideration in the bidding process, in accordance with the tender terms and applicable procurement rules. The supplier shall provide a live demonstration of the drone, equipment, accessories, or spare parts, wherever applicable, befor e final acceptance of the product. The demonstration shall verify the product's functionality, performance, specifications, and compatibility with the existing drone system. The purchaser reserves the right to reject any product that fails to meet the agree d specifications or demonstration requirements. 2. Product Specifications and Compatibility All supplied items must be brand new, genuine, unused, and as per the approved make, model, part number, and technical specifications mentioned in the Purchase Order. Drone spare parts, batteries, flight controllers, motors, ESCs, propellers, camer as, sensors, communication modules, and other accessories must be compatible with the intended drone model. No substitution shall be permitted without prior written approval from the purchaser. 3. Installation, Integration and Commissioning The supplier shall provide installation, fitting, integration, configuration, calibration, and commissioning of the supplied drone ite ms or spare parts, wherever applicable. Installation shall be carried out by qualified technical personnel in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines. The supplied equipment shall be tested to ensure proper functioning before acceptance by the purch aser. Charges for installation and commissioning must be clearly specified in the quotation. 4. Testing and Acceptance All items shall be subject to inspection and functional testing by the purchaser. Acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory demonstration, installation (where applicable), and verification of the agreed technical requirements. If any item is found defect ive, incompatible, damaged, or non-functional, the supplier shall rectify the issue or replace the item at no additional cost, as a greed under the Purchase Order.

5. Warranty and Guarantee The supplier shall provide the applicable manufacturer's warranty and clearly specify the warranty period for each item in the q uotation and invoice. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects and failures attributable to defective materials or workma nship, subject to the manufacturer's warranty terms and applicable law. The supplier shall provide warranty documentation, seri al numbers, and proof of purchase wherever applicable. Any exclusions, particularly for batteries, consumables, crash damage, and misuse, must be disclosed in writing before order confirmation. 6. After-Sales Service and Technical Support The supplier shall provide after-sales service and technical support for all supplied items during the applicable warranty period and, where agreed, after expiry of the warranty. Support shall include fault diagnosis, troubleshooting, repair coordination, repl acement assistance, and technical guidance for installation and operation. The supplier shall provide contact details for its servi ce team and communicate the process for raising service requests. 7. Repair and Replacement of Defective Items Any item found defective during installation, testing, or the applicable warranty period shall be repaired or replaced in accordance with the agreed warranty and service terms. The supplier shall communicate the expected resolution time and bear applicable repair, replacement, and transportation costs where covered under the warranty or otherwise agreed in the Purchase Order. 8. Delivery of Spare Parts and Accessories The supplier shall deliver all ordered items along with the required accessories, connectors, cables, mounting hardware, manual s, calibration information, and other components specified in the Purchase Order. All supplied parts must be properly packed an d protected against damage during transportation. 9. Training and Technical Documentation Where required, the supplier shall provide basic operating instructions, installation guidance, maintenance instructions, troubles hooting documentation, and technical training for the purchaser's authorized personnel. Any charges for training or specialized technical support must be agreed upon in advance. .
